Team —

Attaching the latest watchlist snapshot (watchlist_snapshot_20261124.csv). Finance needs a cleaned-up list of deals we consider "at-risk" (red), "watch" (yellow), and "committed" (green) by EOD Monday 11/30 for the FYQ4 forecast refresh. Please do the following: 

- Update stage to the most accurate value in HubSpot (commit / negotiation / PO / procurement).
- Mark risk color (R/Y/G) in the sheet and add 1–2 line rationale.
- For any reds, attach the proposed save plan (one-pager) or note owner if you're escalating.
- Call out any changes that would move ARR in/out of the quarter.

I'll consolidate inputs and send a single save-plan tracker to finance. Thanks — tight timeline here.

Priya Natarajan

Priya —

Quick update on Brightline Health: procurement has pushed their internal signing committee to the week of Dec 7 due to budget cadence misalignment. I've moved the deal to YELLOW in the sheet and added a note: "Procurement delay; exec sponsor engaged; request 2-week extension."

Context: Legal and security have already cleared the SOW; commercial negotiation is wrapped except for final term on payment milestone. If we can't get a PO before 12/01 the uplift will likely slip to next quarter.

Next steps I'm taking:
- I scheduled an exec re-connect with Kyle Moran (Brightline) for 11/27 to secure a verbal commitment.
- Drafting a trial-extension agreement to buy runway.

Connor

- Goal: preserve $420k ARR in FYQ4 by securing a PO or confirmed billing milestone by 12/01.
- Actions (owners):
  1) Exec re-intro + ask for verbal commit (Connor) — target 11/27.
  2) Offer two-week trial extension + temporary production access (SDR/CS support) (Marissa) — send by 11/27.
  3) Provide revised payment milestone to match their budget cadence (Karthik to approve discount cap).
  4) If PO not received by 12/01 escalate to Sales Leadership for holdback decision (Priya).

Thanks for the details. A couple of finance constraints to note before we lock the save-plan: 

- Discount cap for FYQ4 is 15% without executive approval; anything above requires Legal + Finance sign-off and will reduce recognized ARR in quarter of execution.
- Trial-extension credits can be recognized as deferred revenue until billing milestones are met — we need the expected invoice date to model cash flow.

Please add expected invoice/PO date to the Brightline row in the sheet. If the expected PO slips past 12/05 we'll need to treat $420k as out-of-quarter for conservative forecasting.

Karthik
